description: A customizable AI chat with multiple providers (OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic/Claude, OpenRouter, Kimi, Qwen, and free NVIDIA models).
viewsContainers.chat.title: OpenVS Thor
views.chat.name: OpenVS Thor
config.skills: Custom skills (named instruction packs) as `{ id, name, description, instructions }`. They appear in the skill picker and `/skill <id>`, and override built-ins with the same id. Skills can also live in `.openvs/skills/<id>.md`.
config.mcp.servers: Global MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, as a map of `id` → `{ command, args, env, cwd }`. Their tools become available to the agent (namespaced `mcp__<id>__<tool>`). Projects can add servers via `.openvs/mcp.json` or `.vscode/mcp.json`. stdio servers only start in a trusted workspace.
config.defaultProvider: The AI provider selected by default when the chat opens.
config.openai.model: Default model for the OpenAI provider.
config.openai.baseUrl: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API. Change this to use a proxy or compatible endpoint.
config.anthropic.model: Default model for the Anthropic provider.
config.anthropic.baseUrl: Base URL for the Anthropic API.
config.nvidia.model: Default model for the NVIDIA provider. NVIDIA offers a generous free tier via build.nvidia.com.
config.nvidia.baseUrl: Base URL for the NVIDIA OpenAI-compatible API.
config.provider.openrouter: OpenRouter (one key, hundreds of models incl. free ones)
config.openrouter.model: Default model for the OpenRouter provider. Models with a ':free' suffix cost nothing.
config.openrouter.baseUrl: Base URL for the OpenRouter API.
config.kimi.model: Default model for the Kimi (Moonshot AI) provider.
config.kimi.baseUrl: Base URL for the Moonshot AI API. Use https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 for China-mainland accounts.
config.qwen.model: Default model for the Qwen (DashScope) provider.
config.qwen.baseUrl: Base URL for DashScope's OpenAI-compatible mode. Use https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 for Beijing-region accounts.
config.custom.model: Default model for the custom provider (e.g. an Ollama model tag).
config.custom.baseUrl: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Defaults to a local Ollama install; point it at LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, or any other compatible server.
config.authUrl: Optional web sign-in URL for this provider. When set, a 'Sign in with web' button is shown; the editor opens this URL with redirect_uri & state query params and stores the token returned to its URI callback. Point this at your own OAuth/proxy service to let users log in instead of pasting a key.
config.agent.maxSteps: Maximum number of tool-use steps the agent may take before pausing.
config.agent.commandTimeoutMs: Maximum time (ms) a shell command run by the agent may take before it is killed.
config.agent.maxSubagents: Maximum number of sub-agents a single run may spawn (cost/safety cap).
config.agent.maxSubagentDepth: How deeply sub-agents may nest (a sub-agent spawning sub-agents). 1 disables nesting.
config.agent.parallelResearch: Run read-only research sub-agents in parallel. Write-capable sub-agents always run sequentially.
config.rules: Always-on instructions ('rules') prepended to every conversation, in addition to the system prompt. Use this to enforce conventions and constraints.
config.ruleFiles: Workspace files to load as rules when present (first lines win on truncation). Lets you keep project rules in the repo, e.g. AGENTS.md or .github/copilot-instructions.md.
config.guardrails.approval: When the agent must ask before side effects. 'always' prompts for every write/command; 'auto-readonly' is the same for writes but never prompts for read-only tools; 'auto-edits' auto-approves file edits inside the workspace but still prompts for commands (default); 'yolo' auto-approves writes and commands (use with care).
config.guardrails.approval.always: Prompt before every file write and command (safest).
config.guardrails.approval.autoReadonly: Prompt before writes/commands; never prompt for read-only tools.
config.guardrails.approval.autoEdits: Auto-approve file edits inside the workspace; still prompt before running commands (default).
config.guardrails.approval.yolo: Auto-approve writes and commands without prompting (dangerous).
config.guardrails.deniedCommands: Regular expressions (case-insensitive). A command matching any of these is blocked outright, before approval.
config.guardrails.allowedCommands: If non-empty, the agent may ONLY run commands matching one of these regular expressions (an allow-list).
config.guardrails.protectedPaths: Glob-like patterns the agent may never write to (e.g. .git, .env, key files).
config.auto.decompose: In Auto + Agent mode, split the plan into steps and run a sub-agent per step (planner decomposition) instead of a single implementer.
config.auto.planModel: Model used for the **planning** phase when the provider is set to **Auto**. Format: `provider:model` (e.g. `anthropic:claude-opus-4-0`). Leave empty to let OpenVS pick the best available model based on which keys are configured.
config.auto.codeModel: Model used for the **implementation** phase in **Auto** mode. Format: `provider:model` (e.g. `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-0`). Must be a tool-capable model. Leave empty to auto-select.
config.auto.reviewModel: Model used for the **review** phase in **Auto** mode. Format: `provider:model` (e.g. `openai:gpt-4o`). Leave empty to auto-select.
config.auto.enableReview: When using Auto mode in Agent, run a final review pass over the agent's changes with the review model.
config.systemPrompt: System prompt prepended to every conversation.
config.maxTokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate per response round. When a response hits this limit, the chat automatically continues it in place (up to 8 rounds), so long answers and big code blocks are not cut off midway. Non-inline Edit mode (which asks for a whole file back) always uses at least 8192 regardless of this setting.
